analysis_notes.good_evil_mirror_note: Torah #197 demonstrates the classic good/evil mirror structure. Package 1 (ענוה וחכמה — true humility bonded with wisdom, exemplified by Moshe) is the exact positive mirror of Package 2 (עֲנָוָה פְּסוּלָה — false humility severed from wisdom, produced by lashon hara). The structural parallelism is explicit: where Package 1 has the inseparable union of ענוה+חכמה, Package 2 has their separation. Where Package 1 has Moshe as the exemplar who transcended the damage, Package 2 has the fools who perform כְּפִיפַת רֹאשׁ בְּדֶרֶךְ שְׁטוּת. This is a textbook example of the framework's good/evil mirror.
